title: At Miami AI Summit, Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue predicts every company will become an AI builder
hook_text: Every company becomes an AI builder
hook_before: Clem Delangue says every company will soon become an AI builder.
script:
Every company becomes an AI builder, says Hugging Face. This outlook came from the Miami AI Summit.
He shared this outlook at the Miami AI Summit this week.
Delangue believes internal tools will shift toward custom AI model development.
Companies currently rely on third-party software for core operations.
Building proprietary models gives businesses control over their own data.
Most businesses now use open source libraries to deploy these systems.
Will your employer start training its own models next year?

editor.one_line: Weak hook and repetitive, low-effort visuals fail to meet premium news standards.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Replace 'Every company becomes an AI builder' with 'Clem Delangue: Every company will soon build its own AI models.'
LINE 2: Remove this line entirely; it is redundant filler.
LINE 4: Replace 'third-party software' with specific examples like 'SaaS platforms like Salesforce or Workday.'
LINE 6: Replace 'open source libraries' with 'Hugging Face’s open-source ecosystem' to add brand relevance.
visual_notes: line 1: Uses a generic emoji instead of a professional photo of Clem Delangue or the summit.
line 2: Redundant line with no visual value; wastes screen time.
